author: klinken

title: Fin, enkel app uden dikkedarer
body: Læg opgaver under lister og gruppér dem, sæt alarmer på dem og kvittér ved udførelse. Bruger du Gmail, kan du arbejde med opgaverne fra en pc. Ellers skal du have en tredjeparts app. Kræver Google account. OBS på at man skal bladre; søgefunktion findes ej i denne app, men det kan tredjeparts apps fixe. Brug denne app til at logge arbejdstid, blodtryk og indkøbslister. Det er den god til.

author: Jensbt

title: Great but lacking ability to search
body:
I live that Google tasks stays synced across my work account.

But I'm missing the ability to search my tasks within the app.
author: Patrick Alessi

title: OK but needs easy improvements
body:
1) Not possible to fold subtasks under main task. Also, only possible to add one layer under the main task.
2) Adding a date and time is good but barely usable when not possible to add time interval! Adding time slot 'from' and 'to' should be a possibility.
3) Adding a date and time adds a reminder in the calendar view but not in the google calender as such. It adds in a task the task calender which can be viewed in the calendar. If you view your Google calendar in another application this is not viewable which makes it not very useful.
author: JeppeKN

title: God og nyttig app
body: Generelt mange muligheder for at organisere/huske diverse gøremål/opgaver. Dog mangler der en mulighed for en indbygget kalender, så man hurtigt kan se, hvilke opgaver der er planlagt til en valgt dag.

title: NOT TO TRUST
body:
NOT WORKING AS IT SHOULD ON iOS.
Once you get notifications, sometimes not.
All permissions are fixed in settings, newest version updated, not special focus mode enabled.
Missed important events by not getting notifications in correct time. Considering to find alternative to it and it's not trustworthy anymore.
author: kt100489

title: Notifikationer/timers
body: Jeg elsker appen. Den er simpel og let at bruge. Mit eneste ønske er dog hvis man kunne få notifikationer på sine opgaver. Ligesom dem man har i beskeder. Evt en reminder/pop up funktion. Til kommende opgaver. 😁😆

title: No development
body:
No visible development of this app for 8 years.
Must be underprioritized by google.
No subtasks available.
Cannot add files to tasks. 
Assigning priorities to tasks extremely basic.

Please make it more inviting to use with occasional updates etc.
